negative_anchor.reason_for_followup: Expanding every ragged-kernel accumulator array from three to four changed the compiled one-to-three-row path and collapsed all target outputs to token ID zero. The speed number is not promotable.

hypothesis: Compile-time-specialized three-row and four-row implementations can preserve the already-qualified one-to-three-row binary path while allowing a separate four-accumulator exact-four-row kernel, avoiding the v3 runtime-sized array regression.

implementation.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order v1 and promoted fused one-to-three-row v2
required_structure: instantiate the fused kernel with MAX_ROWS=3 for one-to-three-row calls
instantiate a distinct MAX_ROWS=4 path only for exactly four rows
retain the existing GEMM path for batches larger than four
do not enlarge the MAX_ROWS=3 accumulator or Q8 sum arrays

stop_rules: Stop before MTP if any ordinary-decode canary token differs or degenerates.
Stop before the four-prompt run if the first MTP3 prompt changes any committed token or draft acceptance count.
Reject if the four-row graph speedup is below 1.10.
Reject if terminal MTP3 throughput improves by less than five percent.
Do not interpret a faster graph with invalid logits as a performance result.
claim_boundary: A pass promotes one exact-four-row AVX2 verification kernel on four Milan cores. The trained approximation, broad quality, final-node, energy, 100 accepted tok/s, and novelty gates remain open.
